title: Curriculum
description: Create and organize modules, lessons, exams, and materials. Every change is versioned.
emptyHint: Create a curriculum to start adding modules, lessons, and exams.
confirmDelete: Previous versions are kept. This removes the latest version from the outline.

historyHint: Open a previous version in the viewer. Editing always saves a new latest version.

fields.titleDescription: Shown in lists, the outline, and the learner view.

fields.ownerDescription: Assign an owner to this curriculum
fields.typeDescription: How this material should be presented.

fields.durationDescription: Optional time limit for the exam.
